verdict.rationale: Only one data point touches mobile at all — an iOS lock-screen widget for starting audio memos (reflect-docs-52) — with no documentation of an Android app, or of full search/linking parity on either mobile platform; community discussion focuses on desktop vs. Obsidian/Bear, not mobile experience. Missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, evidence of full capture/search/linking parity on iOS, and independent/hands-on mobile app reviews.
